output_list.criticism: The contract uses the current block number as a dependency, which can be manipulated by miners. This vulnerability can lead to unauthorized actions, loss of funds, and other potential issues.

The contract has deposit and withdrawal functions, but they are not properly secured. Anyone can transfer gold to the contract, and anyone can withdraw gold from the contract. This vulnerability can lead to unauthorized actions, loss of funds, and other potential issues.

The contract has a level up function, but it is not properly secured. Anyone can level up any hero, regardless of their ownership. This vulnerability can lead to unauthorized actions, loss of funds, and other potential issues.

The contract has a deploy function, but it is not properly secured. Anyone can deploy any hero, regardless of their ownership. This vulnerability can lead to unauthorized actions, loss of funds, and other potential issues.

The contract has an add exp function, but it is not properly secured. Anyone can add exp to any hero, regardless of their ownership. This vulnerability can lead to unauthorized actions, loss of funds, and other potential issues.
